figures.base4: picture-sequence of three photos: chick, young hen, hen
figures.heading: A chick grows into a hen
figures.lead: A hen lays an egg. A chick hatches and grows into a hen.

figure.intent: a chicken's life cycle in order: egg, chick, young hen, adult hen, and back to the egg
figure.alt: A chicken's life cycle: an egg hatches into a chick, which grows into a hen that lays eggs.

figures.base4: fraction-shapes: two squares, one half and one quarter shaded
figures.heading: Equal parts
figures.lead: Equal parts are the same size.

figure.intent: one half and one quarter of the same-sized whole, side by side, so pupils see a quarter is smaller
figure.alt: Two equal wholes: one cut into two equal parts with one shaded, one cut into four equal parts with one shaded.

figures.base4: equal-groups: 12 counters in two rings of six
figures.heading: Find half of 12
figures.lead: Share 12 counters into two equal groups.

figure.intent: 12 counters shared one at a time into 2 equal groups of 6
figure.alt: Twelve counters shared into two equal groups of six.

figures.base4: equal-groups: 20 counters in five rings of four
figures.heading: Find ⅕ of 20

figure.intent: one fifth of 20 counters: 20 shared into 5 equal groups, one group picked out
figure.alt: Twenty counters in five equal groups of four; one group is one fifth.

figures.base4: bar-model: 20 in five parts of four, three shaded
figures.heading: Find ⅗ of 20

figure.intent: a bar of 20 split into 5 equal parts of 4, with 3 parts making 12
figure.alt: A bar of 20 in five equal parts of 4; three parts together make 12.
